topics.title: MCP 2026-07-28 spec update — stateless core, Tasks/Extensions framework, MCP Apps, auth hardening; what changed since fundamentals
topics.description: MCP 2026-07-28 spec update — stateless core, Tasks/Extensions framework, MCP Apps, auth hardening; what changed since fundamentals

resources.title: MCP 2026-07-28 Spec Update — Stateless Core, Tasks/Extensions, MCP Apps, Auth Hardening
resources.content: MCP's biggest spec revision since launch: protocol goes stateless at the core (servers run behind plain load balancers, header-based routing, cacheable tools/list), Tasks move out of experimental core into a formal io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension with poll-based tasks/get + tasks/update, a new formal Extensions framework, MCP Apps for server-rendered UIs, OAuth/OIDC-aligned auth hardening, and a 12-month deprecation policy (Roots/Sampling/Logging deprecated, legacy HTTP+SSE transport on a year-long offramp). Read this right after MCP fundamentals (L110) to know what changed since.

resources.title: Build an MCP Server (hands-on, Python + TypeScript)
resources.content: Official step-by-step tutorial: build a real MCP server exposing tools/resources/prompts, run it against the MCP Inspector (`npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector ...`) to test locally, then connect it to a live client. Covers FastMCP decorators (Python) vs explicit Zod schemas (TypeScript). Turns MCP from a read-only concept into something you've actually shipped — direct prereq for the agent-native capstone (T25).
